ACT IV OF 2010
ACT IV OF 2010
AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2009
An Act to further amend the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939
[Gazette of Sindh
Extraordinary, Part IV,
4th March, 2010]
No. PAS/Legis-B-25/2009, dated., 4-3-2010.---The
Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Bill, 2009 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 21st December, 2009
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 17th
February, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939, in the
manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(l)
This Act may be called the Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Act, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Omission of sections 3 and 4 of Act V of 1939
